sources: build_day/cook_api.py ROUTINES + runs/run05/run.json (demo routines and the executed 西红柿炒蛋 sequence)

types.purpose: Everything before the heat goes on: cold box out, tomatoes cut, seasonings dosed into cups, pour drum loaded.
types.hardware_needed: fridge cold box, lever cutter, seasoning station, pour drum
types.notes: In the demo only tomato is cut by the robot; eggs come pre-beaten. Other ingredients need the prep_* types below.

types.purpose: Heat the wok (with oil or food) at a power level until the thermometer reads the target (油温 N 成热).
types.notes: No arm motion.

types.purpose: Heat off (plume rule), arm pours a cup / bowl into the wok, heat back to level.
types.example_quote: 热油倒出之后直接下入调好的茄汁

types.purpose: Leave the food to fry without stirring (煎 / 定型).
types.example_quote: 油温升至6成热之后我们把处理好的鱼骨头下

types.purpose: Turn the piece over with the spatula, fry the other side.
types.notes: Flipping a single piece is not simulated (uses the scrape stroke).
types.example_quote: 锅烧热之后加入适量的底油烧至5成热

types.purpose: Set the heat and stir with the spatula for a time.
types.example_quote: 继续开中大火翻炒出辣椒的锅气

types.purpose: Release the next drum compartment (liquid / sauce / oil from the edge) and stir straight after it, no pause.

parameters.name: what
parameters.typical: water, ketchup, soy, vinegar, wine, finishing oil, sauce

types.notes: Covers 锅边淋 soy / vinegar / wine, 明油, dissolved seasoning water. Ingredients other than the model's are not simulated.
types.example_quote: 热油倒出之后直接下入调好的茄汁

types.purpose: Heat off and tip the whole wok into the plate (serve + rinse), the holding bowl, or the oil cup.
types.hardware_needed: keyed wok grip, faucet lever block
types.notes: Plate tip ≤ 1150 g food (PGC 6.47 of 7 N·m). holding_bowl / oil_cup return path not re-run.
types.example_quote: 最后加入炸好的里脊翻炒均匀即可出锅装盘

types.purpose: Heat off, pour the holding bowl back, heat on and stir.
types.example_quote: 最后加入炸好的里脊翻炒均匀即可出锅装盘

types.purpose: Heat off, pour the seasoning cups in (salt, sugar, ...), heat on and stir so they dissolve evenly.
types.notes: Added to the demo after run05 (run05 poured salt and sugar as two add_off_heat calls).
types.example_quote: 煮/焖

types.purpose: Heat the empty wok, add oil, heat it, pour the hot oil out, add fresh cold oil (热锅冷油, non-stick film).
types.notes: Exactly what run05 did (pour cup1 → heat_to 150 → take_out oil_cup → add cup2). His 晃锅 (swirl) is replaced by the tip to the oil cup, which wets the wall.
types.example_quote: 锅烧热之后加入适量的油滑锅

types.purpose: Pour beaten egg into oil at temperature, fry still until the underside sets, flip, fry, tip into the holding bowl.
types.stop_condition: clock (camera rule optional: no liquid sheen on top)
types.notes: The demo did these 5 calls one by one; as one routine there is no gap between pour and still-fry.
types.example_quote: 热锅滑油之后小火煎成略微老一点的荷包蛋

types.purpose: Add an ingredient off heat, then stir at a level for a time (炒 / 炒至断生 / 炒匀).
types.stop_condition: clock; optional camera rule (colour change / wilt area)
types.notes: Runs in the demo with tomato (add_off_heat + stir_fry). Other ingredients: same calls, not in the wok model; shreds / leafy need the unverified stroke set.
types.example_quote: 家庭小灶这一步大概需要1分钟左右

types.purpose: Oil at temperature, aromatics (姜蒜葱 / 干辣椒 / 花椒) in, short stir until fragrant, then the next ingredient goes in at once.

parameters.name: what
parameters.typical: 姜蒜葱, 干辣椒, 花椒, 泡椒

types.stop_condition: clock 10–30 s; abort early if thermometer > 200 °C (smell has no sensor: time + temperature proxy)
types.notes: Aromatics are not in the wok model; CUP_POUR_wok not verified, stir set partially verified.
types.example_quote: 姜蒜末下锅之后必须翻炒出香味

types.purpose: Paste (豆瓣 / 火锅底料 / 甜面酱) into low-heat oil, often with the wok off heat first, stir until the oil turns red.

parameters.name: what
parameters.typical: 豆瓣, 豆豉, 火锅底料, 甜面酱

types.stop_condition: camera rule: oil hue red (a* threshold) or clock; cap thermometer ≤ 140 °C
types.notes: Paste from a cup: sticky; scraping the cup is not designed.
types.example_quote: 油温5成热之后把锅离火

types.purpose: Meat (五花 / 肉末 / 腊肉) in a little oil, medium-low, stirred until the fat runs and it curls or crisps.

parameters.name: what
parameters.typical: 五花片/粒, 肉末, 牛肉粒

types.example_quote: 肉末放进去给它

types.purpose: Long low-medium stir until surface water is gone (酸菜) or skins wrinkle (四季豆); pour excess oil off mid-way.
types.stop_condition: clock; thermometer rise (> 120 °C = water gone); camera wrinkle texture
types.example_quote: 大概这里是二两

types.purpose: Marinated meat into warm oil (120 °C), do not move until the bottom sets, break apart with gentle strokes until colour changes, optionally take out.
types.notes: Shreds need the unverified shreds stroke. Batter-coated pieces for deep-frying use deep_fry instead.
types.example_quote: 把油温烧至6成热（约180度）

types.purpose: Rock sugar with a little oil/water on low heat until amber, then boiling water or the meat goes in at once.
types.stop_condition: camera: amber hue reached, or thermometer ≥ 165 °C, or max_s
types.notes: Timing-critical (burns in seconds): this is the case routines are for. Caramel is not in the wok model.
types.example_quote: 重新加入冰糖20克下锅

types.purpose: Release starch water or a starch-containing bowl sauce (碗汁/料汁) from the drum and stir until the sauce coats.

parameters.name: sauce
parameters.typical: starch_water | 碗汁 | 茄汁 | 料汁

types.stop_condition: camera gloss rule (specular area on sauce > threshold, no free liquid at the wok bottom) or max_s
types.notes: The brief's example: the LLM pause between release and stir made the sauce lumpy. starch_water is in the wok model; the gloss rule is not in the camera model yet (time cap only).
types.example_quote: 热油倒出之后直接下入调好的茄汁

types.purpose: Heat off, starch water to the centre, gentle push strokes, heat back to low; repeat 2–4 times (麻婆豆腐 / 脑花豆腐).
steps: repeat: set_heat(0), drum_release, stir(push strokes), set_heat(level), wait(interval_s)
types.stop_condition: passes done; camera gloss rule on the last pass
types.notes: Soft tofu needs a push stroke, not the scrape stroke.
types.example_quote: 调好味之后将锅离火

types.purpose: Liquid in (drum / WOK_FILL), bring to the boil, hold at a level for a time; optional skim and basting.

parameters.name: liquid
parameters.typical: water, stock, cola, beer, 糖色

types.stop_condition: clock after the thermometer reads ≥ 98 °C; boil-dry guard: > 110 °C stops
types.notes: Water is in the wok model (run05 simmered 50 s). Skimming (撇浮沫) has no tool: skipped or spider (SPIDER_SCOOP_wok, not verified). > 1 L needs WOK_FILL.
types.example_quote: 热油倒出之后直接下入调好的茄汁

types.purpose: Liquid in, boil, lid on, hold at a level for a time (30 s 焖 on high up to 60 min braise), lid off.
types.stop_condition: clock; boil-dry guard on the thermometer
types.notes: Wok lid sets are not verified (meal A 西兰花, meal B 红烧肉 / 番茄炒蛋 need them).
types.example_quote: 然后将鲤鱼下锅烧6分钟

types.purpose: Uncovered, medium-high, stir now and then until the liquid is thick and glossy (no starch).
types.stop_condition: thermometer of the bottom rises above ~105 °C (water gone) or camera gloss, or max_s
types.example_quote: 然后放这个汤

types.purpose: Dry wok very hot, slab of pork skin-down, sear until the skin is golden and blistered, lift it out.
steps: lift slab to the sink tray
types.hardware_needed: gripper finger set for raw meat
types.notes: He moves the slab around to sear evenly; one arm can do it but the grip on a hot slab is not designed.
types.example_quote: 煎 (烙皮: dry-sear the

types.purpose: Heat off, coated slices in one by one, low heat ~15 s, gentle push, lift into the serving bowl with the spider.
types.notes: SPIDER_SCOOP_wok not verified (only the pot scoop is).
types.example_quote: 然后将锅离火

types.purpose: Lift a named item (葱段, 姜, bones + 酸菜, a piece) out of the liquid with the spider.

types.name_en: Pour off excess oil, keep food
types.purpose: Tip the wok so the excess oil runs out while the food stays in.
steps: (he holds the food back with the ladle while tipping)
types.notes: One arm cannot hold the food back and tip at once. Workaround: spider the food into the holding bowl, take_out(oil_cup), add back (3 sets, +~40 s); or use less oil so no pour-off is needed.
types.example_quote: 大概这里是二两

types.purpose: Ladle sauce over a whole fish / piece without turning it.
types.notes: Workaround: lid on (braise_lid) instead of basting.

types.purpose: Heat oil in the wok to 180–240 °C, heat off, tip the wok so the oil runs over the food / aromatics in a bowl or plate.
types.notes: R17: a 6–8 cm bowl at the plating spot was hit by the forearm during the wok pick; hot-oil pour not verified.
types.example_quote: 然后准备适量的植物油烧至6成热

types.purpose: Oil (fryer or wide oil in the wok) to temperature, food in, do not stir until set, separate, fry for a time, lift out with the spider; pass 2 = hotter, shorter.
types.stop_condition: clock; oil thermometer held at target; camera: golden colour
types.notes: Use the fryer, not 750 g of oil in the wok. Pieces added one by one (逐步下入) become one pour; battering (挂糊) is prep [missing].

types.purpose: Carry the wok to the faucet, fill ~1 L, set it back (for soups, blanching water, 煮).
types.notes: WOK_FILL is composed from the verified wok chain (micro-joins checked in R19, 1 L load PGC 5.88 N·m). Flow volume not calibrated; > 1 L not checked.
types.example_quote: 辅料翻炒均匀之后再将事先准备好的热水下锅

types.purpose: Wok to the sink, rinse under the running tap, dump, back on the cooker.
types.notes: Composed from verified sets. Rinse only (no scrubbing). The spatula rest ↔ faucet transits are not verified (R19 §1).

stats.covered_definition: A phase is covered when every routine call mapped to it has covered=true: a library routine runs it with one arm as written or with a stated workaround that keeps the dish. covered=false = one arm cannot do it as written (two_hands) or mid-cook knife work with no tool (cooked meat slicing, mincing). Covered does not mean executable today: see phase_worst_status.
